name: Inuzuka Chunin

entries.name: Beast Master
entries.text: When your Nin-Dog would take damage, you can command it, as a reaction, to reposition itself to a space adjacent to you. When it does, it gains resistance to that instance of damage and moves up to twice its full movement to accomplish your order.

entries.name: Superior Skill
entries.text: When you make an ability check with a skill you are proficient in, you may add 1d6 to your check. Additionally, if your ability checks are ever contested, you instead add 2d6.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.text: The Inuzuka Chunin may make two unarmed attacks or two attacks with its currently equipped weapons.

entries.name: Unarmed Strike
entries.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning or slashing damage.

entries.name: Shuriken
entries.text: Ranged Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d4 + 3) slashing damage.

notes: Fang Over Fang is printed "Fang Over Fant".

name: Nin-Dog

entries.name: Terrain Advantage
entries.text: Immunity to difficult terrain. Gain a +10 bonus to speed while in an area of difficult terrain.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.text: The Nin-Dog may make two bite attacks.

entries.name: Bite
entries.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d10 + 3) piercing damage. If this attack deals damage, the Nin-Dog may attempt to grapple the target as a free action.

notes: Printed as a Medium Beast companion of the Inuzuka clan; clan_slug groups it with the Inuzuka templates. Passive Perception 26 includes Bestial Senses' +10 on top of the +6 Perception skill.
